content_sections.heading: BMC Shikshan Sevak Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The 935 vacancies for Shikshan Sevak 2026 are distributed across four streams: Each stream carries its own category-wise reservation breakup (SC, ST, VJ-A, NT-B, NT-C, NT-D, SBC, OBC, EWS, SEBC, and Open), along with horizontal reservation for women (30%), ex-servicemen (15%), project-affected (5%), earthquake-affected (2%), sportspersons (5%), part-time graduates/educated unemployed (10%), orphans (1%), and persons with disabilities (4%). The notification states that the number of vacancies and the reservation break-up may increase or decrease before final recruitment.

content_sections.heading: BMC Shikshan Sevak Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements differ by stream and by the class level being taught (Classes 1–5 or Classes 6–8 for Marathi/English medium), and by discipline for the Art and Music special-teacher posts. All candidates must additionally have passed Marathi as a subject (minimum 100 marks in Marathi-medium schools, minimum 50 marks in other-medium schools) at SSC/HSC or equivalent level, and must hold an MSCIT (or government-recognized equivalent) computer certificate — candidates without it at the time of application must clear MSCIT within 2 years of appointment, failing which their service will be terminated.

rows.minimum_qualification: HSC (or equivalent) with minimum 50% marks + 2-year D.Ed (Primary Teacher Education) in the relevant medium, OR 4-year B.El.Ed in the relevant medium, OR Degree (min. 50%) + B.Ed in the relevant medium. Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) is compulsory.
Relevant-subject Degree (min. 50%) + 2-year D.Ed or 1-year B.Ed in the relevant medium, OR 4-year B.El.Ed/B.A.Ed/B.Sc.Ed in the relevant medium. TET is compulsory.

10th/12th pass + government-recognized degree/diploma in Painting, Fine Arts or Applied Arts; minimum 5 years' teaching experience in a recognized institution; minimum 2 years' experience conducting special art-exam classes.

10th/12th pass + government-recognized degree/diploma in Music (Sangeet Visharad, vocal, instrumental, dance, or instrumental music); minimum 5 years' teaching experience; minimum 3 years' experience preparing and conducting music programs.

content_sections.heading: BMC Shikshan Sevak Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on the TAIT 2025 examination period (27.05.2025 to 05.06.2025): Open (unreserved) category: 18 to 38 years Backward class categories: 18 to 43 years Ex-servicemen: military service period + 3 years, subject to a maximum of 45 years (disabled ex-servicemen also capped at 45 years) Project-affected / earthquake-affected candidates: up to 45 years Sportspersons: 5-year relaxation, capped at a maximum of 43 years for any category Part-time graduates (educated unemployed): up to 55 years Orphan candidates: up to 43 years Persons with disabilities (minimum 40% disability, certified): up to 45 years Nominated dependents of freedom fighters: up to 45 years No age limit applies to candidates already in BMC service, subject to a No Objection Certificate from their department head Creamy-layer candidates within VJ/NT/SBC/OBC categories are not eligible for backward-class age relaxation

content_sections.heading: BMC Shikshan Sevak Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify an application fee amount. Fee details, if applicable, will be indicated on the Pavitra Portal at the time of application.

content_sections.heading: BMC Shikshan Sevak Salary
content_sections.text: Selected Shikshan Sevak candidates will receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 16,000 per month. This is an honorarium (मानधन) for the Shikshan Sevak position rather than a regular pay-scale salary; the notification does not specify a separate pay matrix.

content_sections.heading: BMC Shikshan Sevak Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection under this notification is based on candidates' scores in the Teacher Aptitude and Intelligence Test (TAIT) 2025, conducted between 27.05.2025 and 05.06.2025, followed by: Preparation of a combined merit list based on TAIT 2025 scores, category-wise and parallel (horizontal) reservation Document verification of original educational, caste, and other supporting certificates Police character and antecedent verification Medical examination (through BMC's medical board; candidates selected under the disability quota are examined by BMC's Medical Board, which must certify fitness before appointment) Final selection list published on the BMC portal, subject to certificate verification Selected candidates are appointed on a 3-year probationary period and must deposit a security amount equal to one month's honorarium (refundable, interest-free, after probation) before joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BMC Shikshan Sevak Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Maharashtra Government's Pavitra Portal link available on BMC's website, portal.mcgm.gov.in . Register using a valid, regularly-used personal email ID, which must remain active throughout the recruitment process (all communication is sent online). Only one application is allowed per candidate; if multiple applications are submitted, only the last one will be considered valid. Submit the application before the closing date indicated on the Pavitra Portal (not specified in this notification).

faq.question: Q1. What is BMC Shikshan Sevak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Education Department of Brihanmumbai Mahanagarpalika (BMC/MCGM) to fill 935 Group-C Shikshan Sevak (Teaching Fellow) posts across Marathi medium, English medium, Art, and Music streams, notified vide No. EOR/OD/113 dated 09.07.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under BMC Shikshan Sevak 2026?
faq.answer: There are 935 total vacancies: 525 in Marathi medium, 352 in English medium, 10 for Art (Chitrakala) special teacher, and 48 for Music (Sangeet) special teacher.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BMC Shikshan Sevak 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 August 2026. Candidates should check the Pavitra Portal (portal.mcgm.gov.in) for the current application window.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BMC Shikshan Sevak 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post: HSC + D.Ed (or B.El.Ed) for primary teachers (Classes 1–5), a relevant Degree + D.Ed/B.Ed for upper-primary teachers (Classes 6–8), and a recognized degree/diploma plus teaching experience for the Art and Music special-teacher posts. TET is compulsory for Marathi/English medium posts, and Marathi-subject and MSCIT qualifications are required across all streams.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BMC Shikshan Sevak 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18–38 years for open-category candidates and 18–43 years for backward-class candidates, reckoned as on the TAIT 2025 exam period (27.05.2025–05.06.2025), with further relaxations for ex-servicemen, project/earthquake-affected candidates, sportspersons, part-time graduates, orphans, and persons with disabilities.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for BMC Shikshan Sevak 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify an application fee amount.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BMC Shikshan Sevak 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on candidates' scores in the Teacher Aptitude and Intelligence Test (TAIT) 2025, followed by preparation of a merit list, document verification, police character verification, and a medical examination.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for BMC Shikshan Sevak 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 16,000 per month.
